verdict.rationale: The CRA's own pages confirm that a delegated-access mechanism exists: taxpayers can "authorize access to online information", and representatives request account access through the Represent a Client portal and can file or pay for clients. Nothing in the pack publishes the authorization forms, the defined representative roles or access levels, or what a third party may not do. missing for 10: named authorization forms, published role or access-level definitions, explicit list of actions and signatures that stay personal to the taxpayer, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: representatives will need to use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account.
